systems.name: 6.1 Visual Style & Asset Creation
systems.notes: Hades‑inspired dark aesthetic with neon accents. Hand‑drawn unicorns, enemies, environments, UI.
tasks: Design and animate all 4 unicorns (idle, walk, attack, special, hit, death)
Create enemy sprites for all tiers (16+ enemy types)
UI design (HUD, menus, shop) – sleek, minimal

systems.name: 6.2 Sound Design & Music
systems.notes: Original soundtrack with dynamic intensity. Impactful SFX for hits, horn powers, boss roars.
tasks: Compose main theme and level variants
Dynamic music layers (exploration(leads and rhythm drop out leaving bass track and drums playing), combat(rhythm section joins), boss(lead joins))
SFX: melee swings, horn powers, enemy sounds, UI
Voice acting for boss dialogue (optional) - PCM voices for each boss will work.

systems.name: 6.3 Performance & Optimization
systems.notes: 60 FPS target on mid‑range hardware. Optimise sprite rendering, particle effects, and co‑op path.
